mapper.select: select count(*) from ontology_query_evaluation where proposal_id = #{proposalId} and config_hash = #{configHash} and passed = 1
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_query_evaluation (proposal_id, config_hash, benchmark_version, passed, case_count, passed_count, detail, evaluated_by, evaluated_at) values (#{proposalId}, #{configHash}, #{benchmarkVersion}, #{passed}, #{caseCount}, #{passedCount}, #{detail}, #{evaluatedBy}, current_timestamp) on duplicate key update passed = values(passed), case_count = values(case_count), passed_count = values(passed_count), detail = values(detail), evaluated_by = values(evaluated_by), evaluated_at = current_timestamp
